mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine potentiates noradrenergic and dopaminergic activity while nortriptyline inhibits reuptake of norepinephrine and serotonin, creating additive sympathomimetic effects with risk of hypertension, tachycardia, and arrhythmias; nortriptyline also inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes amphetamine metabolites.
action: Concurrent use requires careful cardiovascular monitoring, baseline and periodic ECG assessment, and blood pressure monitoring; consider dose adjustments or alternative ADHD agents; educate patient on hypertensive/cardiac symptoms.
